page.overview:
Who is Sirius Black I?

Sirius Black (1845–1853) was a pure-blood wizard and a member of the noble House of Black. Sirius was the elder brother of Phineas Nigellus, Elladora and Iola. He died when he was only seven or eight years old for unknown reasons.

Sirius is the name of the brightest star in the night sky. In the Black family there were also Sirius Black (II) (a nephew of Sirius I, son of Phineas Nigellus) and Sirius III, Walburga's and Orion's son.
